hero.title: Ubuzima bw'ababyeyi bwiza kurushaho, buhujwe.
hero.subtitle: MamaCare Rwanda ihuza ababyeyi, imiryango, abajyanama b'ubuzima n'amatsinda y'ubuvuzi kugira ngo bafashe kubaho neza mu gihe cy'inda no kwita ku bana bavutse.

steps.title: Fungura konti yawe
steps.description: Iyandikishe mu rurimi ukunda, Icyongereza cyangwa Ikinyarwanda.

steps.title: Kurikirana urugendo rwawe
steps.description: Reba icyumweru cy'inda yawe, gahunda ziteganyijwe, n'ibyo kwibutswa buri munsi.

steps.title: Guma uhujwe
steps.description: Umujyanama wawe w'ubuzima n'itsinda ryawe bagumana amakuru kandi bashobora kugera kuri wowe.

mothers.title: Ku babyeyi
mothers.description: Amakuru asobanutse ku nda yawe, ibikurikira, n'amakuru y'ubuzima yizewe — byose ahantu hamwe.

families.title: Ku miryango
families.description: Abafasha n'abo mu muryango bashobora gufasha mu bintu by'ingenzi, igihe umubyeyi yemeye gusangira amakuru.

chw.title: Ku bajyanama b'ubuzima
chw.description: Reba mu buryo bworoshye abakeneye gukurikiranwa, kugira ngo nta wusigara inyuma.

officers.title: Ku matsinda y'ubuvuzi
officers.description: Amakuru rusange, arengera ibanga, ku migendekere y'ubuzima bw'ababyeyi mu baturage.

features.title: Ibiranga
items: Kwibutswa ku buryo bwiza ku isuzuma
Ubufasha bwo gukurikirana ku bajyanama b'ubuzima

privacy.title: Ibanga n'umutekano
privacy.description: Amakuru yawe y'ubuzima ni ibanga rikomeye. MamaCare Rwanda ikoresha uburenganzira bushingiye ku ruhare kugira ngo abantu babona gusa amakuru abakwiye, kandi ni wowe ugena ibyo usangira n'umufasha.

cta.title: Witeguye gutangira?
cta.subtitle: Iyandikishe kuri MamaCare Rwanda uyu munsi — ni ku buntu.

disclaimer: MamaCare Rwanda ifasha akazi k'abajyanama b'ubuzima n'abaganga. Ntisuzuma indwara cyangwa ngo isimbure ubuvuzi bw'abanyamwuga.
